jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_cobblestone: Mine stone with a correct tool without Silk Touch. Each stone broken has a 10% chance to drop one bonus Fast Cobblestone alongside the normal cobblestone. Fast Cobblestone also drops from itself when mined with a pickaxe.
jei.fastfurnacev2.fast_coal: Mine coal ore or deepslate coal ore with a correct tool without Silk Touch. Each ore broken has a 10% chance to drop one bonus Fast Coal alongside its normal drops. Fast Coal burns like regular coal in normal furnaces. In a Fast Furnace it burns 50% longer and increases smelting speed to 200% of vanilla speed.
